purpose: Predeclare the exact source families and causal ordering for the GBP BoE reaction-function diagnostic before data extraction, to avoid post-hoc source or threshold selection.

wages.dataset: Average weekly earnings time series / EARN01
wages.vintage_policy: Use superseded previous-version files and their release/superseded timestamps; current revised history may not backfill prior checkpoints.

services_inflation.vintage_policy: Use historical previous versions with explicit release dates; preserve first-known value available at each checkpoint.

front_end.dataset: Daily sterling overnight index swap curve archive
front_end.basis_policy: Single OIS family only; do not mix gilt and OIS tenors inside the confirmation series.
front_end.publication_policy: Treat curve data as available no earlier than the BoE publication schedule; FX evaluation begins after the fixed confirmation window.
